name: Move
typeSystem: Static and strong, with abilities controlling permitted operations. Structs that lack copy and drop have resource-like linear behavior and cannot be copied or implicitly discarded; store and key separately govern use in global storage.
runtime: Compiled to Move bytecode and checked by a bytecode verifier for type and resource safety before execution. Aptos and Sui use distinct Move dialects, frameworks, storage models, and adapted virtual machines.

runtimes.name: Move VM and chain-specific variants
runtimes.role: Execute verified Move bytecode or chain-specific Move dialects; descendants are used by Aptos and Sui, following the original Diem/Libra project.

compilers.name: move build
compilers.role: Compiles Move packages and produces bytecode artifacts; bytecode verification occurs before execution, while the Move Prover is invoked separately.

concurrencyModel: N/A within a single transaction (sequential execution with resource-safety guarantees); some Move-based chains (e.g. Sui, Aptos with Block-STM) execute independent transactions in parallel at the blockchain-client level.
